thread.title: 27 Stocks Moving In Thursday's Pre-Market Session

author: Lisa Levin
title: 27 Stocks Moving In Thursday's Pre-Market Session
text:
Gainers AV Homes, Inc. (NASDAQ: AVHI ) shares rose 24.2 percent to $20.50 in pre-market trading after Taylor Morrison Home Corporation (NYSE: TMHC ) agreed to acquire AV Homes at $21.50 per share in cash and stock. Conn's Inc (NASDAQ: CONN ) rose 20.7 percent to $30.95 in pre-market trading after the company reported better-than-expected results for its first quarter on Thursday. Athersys, Inc. (NASDAQ: ATHX ) rose 20.4 percent to $3.36 in pre-market trading after the company reported expansion of collaboration with Healios. Five Below, Inc. (NASDAQ: FIVE ) rose 16.7 percent to $94.80 in pre-market trading after the company reported better-than-expected results for its first quarter The company also issued strong second quarter and fiscal 2018 earnings and sales guidance. InfoSonics Corporation (NASDAQ: IFON ) shares rose 16.5 percent to $4.30 in pre-market trading after the company announced it's working with Apple Inc (NASDAQ: AAPL ) on Latin American expansion and will expand into U.S. markets pending Apple’s approval. The company also announced it closed a $3.7-million common stock offering. Ophthotech Corp (NASDAQ: OPHT ) shares rose 16.5 percent to $3.26 in pre-market trading after the company disclosed that it has entered into gene therapy agreements with University of Florida and University of Pennsylvania. Axovant Sciences Ltd. (NASDAQ: AXON ) rose 13.2 percent to $5.15 in pre-market trading after climbing 160.00 percent on Wednesday. Zscaler, Inc. (NASDAQ: ZS ) rose 10.9 percent to $34.00 in pre-market trading after reporting a third-quarter earnings and sales beat. The company issued strong fourth-quarter and fiscal 2018 earnings and sales guidance. Changyou.com Limited (NASDAQ: CYOU ) shares rose 10.1 percent to $20.76 in pre-market trading. Legacy Reserves LP (NASDAQ: LGCY ) shares rose 6.8 percent to $6.47 in pre-market trading after gaining 3.41 percent on Wednesday. Pareteum Corporation (NASDAQ: TEUM ) rose 6.1 percent to $2.47 in pre-market trading after the company agreed to acquire Artilium for $104.7 million. Intercept Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: ICPT ) rose 3.8 percent to $76.49 in pre-market trading. ABM Industries, Inc. (NYSE: ABM ) rose 3.5 percent to $30.01 in pre-market trading after reporting upbeat results for its fiscal third quarter. GNC Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: GNC ) rose 3.5 percent to $3.30 in pre-market trading after gaining 4.59 percent on Wednesday. Seaspan Corporation (NYSE: SSW ) gained 3 percent to $8.99 after declining 2.57 percent on Wednesday. Losers Proteostasis Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: PTI ) shares fell 25.5 percent to $3.65 in pre-market trading after data from an ongoing Phase 1 Study of PTI-801 in cystic fibrosis patients showed statistically significant improvement in blood glucose levels and the reversal of hyperglycemia in the diabetic cystic fibrosis subpopulation. MiMedx Group Inc (NASDAQ: MDXG ) fell 23.9 percent to $6.25in pre-market trading. MiMedx reported that it will restate financial statements for FY12-FY16 and interim periods of FY17 related to sales recognition. The company also disclosed that its CFO Michael Senken stepped down in June 6, 2018 and Edward Borkowski has been named as interim CFO. REV Group, Inc. (NYSE: REVG ) fell 16.6 percent to $14.94 in pre-market trading after the company posted downbeat Q2 earnings and lowered its FY18 net income outlook. American Superconductor Corporation (NASDAQ: AMSC ) shares fell 10 percent to $6.30 in pre-market trading. American Superconductor reported upbeat earnings for its fiscal fourth quarter, while sales missed estimates. J M Smucker Co (NYSE: SJM ) shares fell 9.9 percent to $96.00 in pre-market trading after reporting weaker-than-expected Q4 results. Thor Industries, Inc. (NYSE: THO ) fell 8.6 percent to $90.00 in the pre-market trading session after the company reported Q3 miss. The company’s CEO Bob Martin said Q4 earnings will be affected by inflationary prices and impact from tariffs. Curis, Inc. (NASDAQ: CRIS ) shares fell 7.1 percent to $2.22 in pre-market trading. Cloudera, Inc. (NYSE: CLDR ) fell 6.3 percent to $16.10 in pre-market trading despite reporting upbeat quarterly results. Intelsat S.A. (NYSE: I ) fell 6.1 percent to $17.25 in pre-market trading after rising 3.43 percent on Wednesday. MEI Pharma, Inc. (NASDAQ: MEIP ) shares fell 5.6 percent to $4.53 in pre-market trading after rising 15.66 percent on Wednesday. MongoDB, Inc. (NASDAQ: MDB ) fell 4.2 percent to $49.10 in pre-market trading after reporting first-quarter earnings that fell in line with analyst estimates. United Natural Foods, Inc. (NASDAQ: UNFI ) shares fell 3.2 percent to $44.73 in pre-market trading. United Natural Foods reported stronger-than-expected results for its third-quarter and raised its fiscal 2018 outlook.
